title: AI connections
subtitle: AI apps allowed to read your JoyoRogo data. Read-only: nothing can be changed or deleted through a connection.

connector.title: Connector address
connector.hint: Paste this address into Claude or ChatGPT when you add a connector.
connector.guide: Guide: use Claude or ChatGPT with your JoyoRogo data

pro.required: AI connections are a JoyoRogo Pro feature. You can still connect an app, but it can only read your data once Pro is active.

list.title: Connected apps
list.empty: No AI app is connected yet.
list.emptyHint: Connect from Claude or ChatGPT and the app shows up here.
list.error: Could not load your connections. Try again.

revoke.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
revoke.body: {{name}} can no longer read your data, right away. You can connect it again any time.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.hint: Every time an AI app reads your data it is logged here for 90 days. What is logged: the tool used and its date range, never the data itself.

profile_read.label: Profile and targets
profile_read.desc: Mode (lose, maintain, gain, pregnant), height, age, start and target weight, calorie and protein targets.

food_read.label: Food log
food_read.desc: The food you log each day with calories and macros, and daily totals against your target.

weight_read.label: Body weight
weight_read.desc: Weigh-in history, waist measurements and the trend toward your target.

workouts_read.label: Workouts
workouts_read.desc: Workouts from your JoyoFit watch (duration, distance, heart rate, analysis) and strength sessions. No GPS routes.

recovery_read.label: Sleep and recovery
recovery_read.desc: Hours slept, recovery, readiness, resting heart rate, HRV, VO2max and steps from JoyoFit or Health Connect.
